title: Atlas Project Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a project (projekte/*.md). Architektur Abschn. 4.3. Tasks are GFM checklists in the body, not a frontmatter field. v2 adds refs (Paper cite keys, same join mechanism as atlas.idea refs) — see ADR-0003.
